## ANSWER
Union Station in Washington, DC is at 50 Massachusetts Avenue NE, Washington, DC 20002. [c1] The station's own management site gives this address on its contact page. [c1] Amtrak lists the same address for the station, with the longer ZIP+4 code 20002-4214. [c1] The station fronts Columbus Circle, where Massachusetts Avenue meets First Street NE. [c2]

The pages I found carry no publication date. The address is a fixed street address, so it is unlikely to have changed. A bus-stop listing shows ZIP 20001, but the station's own site and Amtrak both use 20002. [c1]
